name.en: Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM; user reference: DRAM.A)

description.zh: 该基金并非纯 DRAM 现货价格指数，而是主动管理的全球存储器股票组合，覆盖 HBM、DRAM、NAND、SSD 与相关存储公司。它的回报会受成分股权重、估值、汇率与再平衡影响。
description.en: This is not a pure DRAM spot-price index. It is an actively managed global memory-equity portfolio spanning HBM, DRAM, NAND, SSD and related storage companies; weights, valuation, FX and rebalancing matter.

detail.zh: TrendForce 估算 2Q26 DRAM 行业收入环比增长 59.5%；HBM、服务器 DRAM 与企业级 SSD 仍是关键高附加值需求端。
detail.en: TrendForce estimates 2Q26 DRAM industry revenue rose 59.5% QoQ; HBM, server DRAM and enterprise SSD remain the key high-value demand vectors.

value.zh: 供给增速仍落后于需求

detail.zh: TrendForce 指出供应商库存处于历史低位、增量供给主要投向服务器；先进节点迁移、HBM 良率与封装仍是主要约束。
detail.en: TrendForce says supplier inventories remain historically low and incremental supply is mainly allocated to servers; advanced-node migration, HBM yield and packaging remain key constraints.

detail.zh: AI 可改善产品组合，但不能消除库存、扩产与价格回落构成的周期风险。
detail.en: AI can improve mix but does not remove the cycle of inventory, capacity additions and price reversals.

detail.zh: 训练与推理加速器需要高带宽和高能效内存；真正要验证的是良率、认证、封装与长期供货，而不是只看技术参数。
detail.en: Training and inference accelerators need high-bandwidth, efficient memory. Verify yield, qualification, packaging and long-term supply—not specifications alone.

title.zh: 服务器 DRAM：从“位出货”到“每 bit 价值”
title.en: Server DRAM: from bit shipments to value per bit

detail.zh: TrendForce 估算 2Q26 行业收入环比增长 59.5%，同时预计 3Q26 传统 DRAM 合约价涨幅放缓至 13%–18%。更高规格抬升单位价值，但价格增速、库存和新增供给仍决定周期拐点。
detail.en: TrendForce estimates 2Q26 industry revenue rose 59.5% QoQ while conventional DRAM contract-price growth may moderate to 13%–18% in 3Q26. Higher specifications lift value per bit, but pricing momentum, inventory and new supply still determine the cycle.

label.zh: Micron FY26 Q3 业绩电话会材料

title.zh: NAND / 存储：AI 并非单一驱动
title.en: NAND / storage: AI is not the only driver

detail.zh: 企业 SSD 受益于数据中心，但客户端与消费电子仍会影响总体库存、ASP 与经营杠杆。
detail.en: Enterprise SSD benefits from data centers, while client and consumer demand still influence inventory, ASPs and operating leverage.

title.zh: 持有的是“全球存储器权益敞口”，不是单一 DRAM 价格曲线。
title.en: You own global memory-equity exposure, not a single DRAM price curve.

detail.zh: DRAM 的公开资料显示，组合会覆盖 Samsung、SK hynix、Micron 等龙头，并包括 NAND / 存储公司；单一成分股上限、韩国权重和季度再平衡都会让基金表现与某一条现货报价存在偏差。看板应追踪基本面，也应持续查看基金的实际持仓页。
detail.en: DRAM’s public materials show exposure to leaders such as Samsung, SK hynix and Micron alongside NAND/storage companies. Single-name caps, Korean exposure and quarterly rebalancing can make performance diverge from a spot-price series. Track fundamentals and the fund’s actual holdings.

label.zh: Roundhill DRAM 基金页面与持仓

title.zh: HBM4 的量产、良率与客户认证
title.en: HBM4 volume, yield and customer qualification

detail.zh: 技术领先必须变成可持续出货和利润率，才会影响行业盈利中枢。
detail.en: Technology leadership must translate into durable shipments and margins to lift industry earnings power.

title.zh: 价格涨幅放缓与库存是否重建

detail.zh: TrendForce 预计 3Q26 传统 DRAM 合约价环比涨幅放缓至 13%–18%；继续跟踪先进节点迁移、位供给和客户库存是否先于需求加速。
detail.en: TrendForce expects conventional DRAM contract-price growth to moderate to 13%–18% QoQ in 3Q26; track whether node migration, bit supply and customer inventory accelerate ahead of demand.

title.zh: DRAM 实际持仓与权重变化
title.en: Actual DRAM holdings and weight changes

detail.zh: 基金为主动管理，至少按季度核对成分与地域集中度。
detail.en: The ETF is actively managed; verify constituents and geographic concentration at least quarterly.

detail.zh: 价格、库存和扩产的反向变化可能压缩收入与利润。
detail.en: A reversal in pricing, inventory and capacity can compress revenue and profit.

detail.zh: 组合可能集中于少数韩国、美国与台湾的存储器企业。
detail.en: The portfolio can be concentrated in a small group of Korean, U.S. and Taiwanese memory companies.

detail.zh: 主动管理、季度再平衡、汇率与衍生品敞口都可能造成与直觉中的“DRAM 指数”不同的表现。
detail.en: Active management, quarterly rebalancing, FX and derivatives can make performance differ from an intuitive ‘DRAM index.’
